# Shiksha Pilot

> School management software for K-12 schools, covering attendance, examinations
> and report cards, fee collection, timetables and substitutions, leave requests,
> and announcements — accessible from one login across a teacher portal, a
> school-admin portal, a student & parent portal, and a super-admin portal for
> platforms managing multiple schools. An Android app covers attendance marking,
> fee/leave alerts, and PDF report cards/salary slips on the go.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shikshapilot.com/): Product overview — what Shiksha Pilot is, the four portals, and the core modules.
- [Features](https://shikshapilot.com/features): Detailed breakdown of each module — attendance, exams and report cards, fee collection, timetable and substitutions, leave requests, announcements.
- [Mobile App](https://shikshapilot.com/mobile-app): What the Android app does, an FAQ (pricing, iOS availability, offline use), and the download link.
- [Book a Demo](https://shikshapilot.com/contact): Contact form to request a live walkthrough.

## Notes for automated agents

- This site is fully server-rendered PHP; every page's full content is present in the initial HTML response — no JavaScript execution is required to read any page.
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is present on every page: `Organization` sitewide, `SoftwareApplication` on the homepage, `FAQPage` on the mobile app page.
- A machine-readable sitemap is available at [/sitemap.xml](https://shikshapilot.com/sitemap.xml).
- There is no pricing page yet — pricing is not published and should not be inferred or quoted; direct users to [Book a Demo](https://shikshapilot.com/contact) for that.
- The Android app is not yet published to Google Play — the in-page "Get it on Google Play" button is a placeholder, not a live link.
